notes.author: Amber
paragraphs: Since March, fat mass is down another 4.4 lb and lean mass is up 0.7 lb, so body fat is 29.6%. You are a little past halfway from 33.6% toward the 27% goal.
Visceral fat is 1.18 lb, down from 1.52 lb at your first visit. Your legs are still even side to side, and the right arm is a bit leaner than the left, which is common.
The July hip and spine visit stays its own record. This one is the body composition follow-up.
plan: Keep three strength sessions a week, with some single-arm and single-leg work.
Aim for protein at each meal, around 110 g a day.
Your next visit is already on the calendar for December 15. Come in at the same time of day, well hydrated.
